tasks.gr11-email-management-online-risks-t4: Topic: Email management and online risks. Cover e-mail organisation (folders, rules, filters, flags), distribution lists, CC vs BCC, web-based mail vs client mail, spam management, ransomware (how it works, prevention), clickjacking, man-in-the-middle attacks, VPNs, two-factor authentication, and safe online practices. Ask about e-mail-feature matching, threat-type identification, security-measure scenarios, and online-risk questions.
tasks.gr11-ai-ransomware-pat-finalisation-t4: Topic: AI, ransomware and PAT finalisation. Cover artificial intelligence applications (chatbots, recommendation systems, facial recognition), machine learning basics, deepfakes and misinformation, ransomware impact and recovery, PAT phase 3 (finalising and presenting), PAT evidence requirements, and report-writing standards. Ask about AI-application examples, ransomware scenario questions, PAT-phase descriptions, and information-presentation choices.
tasks.gr11-application-integration-case-studie: Topic: Application integration and case studies. Cover integrated document production (embedding spreadsheet data in word processing, linking databases to reports), mail merge with database sources, HTML forms, cross-application data flow, case-study analysis techniques, and social implications of technology (digital divide, e-waste, copyright, cybercrime). Ask about integration-scenario questions, case-study analysis items, social-impact discussions, and cross-application task questions.
tasks.gr11-exam-preparation-consolidation-t4: Topic: Exam preparation and consolidation. Cover theory paper structure and timing, practical paper layout, common exam command words (define, describe, explain, compare, evaluate), hardware/software revision, networks and internet revision, applications revision (word processing, spreadsheets, databases, HTML), PAT revision, and exam technique. Ask about comprehensive mixed-topic MCQs covering the full Grade 11 CAT syllabus, command-word interpretation, and cross-topic integration items.
tasks.gr11-malware-ecommerce-safety-t4: Topic: Malware Categories and Safe E-commerce and E-banking. Cover viruses, worms, spyware and ransomware (described only), social engineering, defences, and safe online shopping and banking with https and SSL. Ask Grade 11 learners to identify a kind of malware or a safe habit.
